feature_name: In-app first-step guide for new trials
summary: A short guide opens at first login and walks new trial users through a first project. It ships behind a flag to a random half of new trials so its effect on 7-day activation can be measured, because the welcome email no longer arrives in time.

statements.text: 248 of 800 September 2026 trials activated within 7 days, 31 percent.
Trials whose welcome email was delayed more than 24 hours activated at 20 percent.
9 of 40 reviewed trial support chats asked where the welcome guide was.
A guide at first login does the job the delayed welcome email no longer does.
One designer and one engineer can build the first version in about two sprints.
The guide's effect on activation is unknown until the A/B test runs.
statements.resolution: The flagged rollout in this PRD's first version is the A/B test from the discovery plan.

objective.text: Get more new trial users to a working first project in their first week, without waiting for email.

key_results.metric: 7-day activation rate in the guide arm

segments.name: New trial users in their first week
segments.job: Get a first project running without outside help, to judge the product inside the trial.
constraints: The welcome email stays unchanged during the test.

value_propositions.why: They need a working first project to decide whether to buy before the trial ends.
value_propositions.before: They wait for a welcome email that a nightly batch can delay by more than a day, then hunt for the guide.
value_propositions.how: A three-step guide opens at first login and walks them through a first project.
value_propositions.after: They create a first project in the first session.
value_propositions.alternatives: The delayed welcome email, searching the help centre, or a support chat.
value_propositions.statement: For new trial users who want a first project fast, the in-app guide replaces waiting for email with three steps at first login.

features.text: Three-step guide panel at first login: name the project, add a first task, invite a teammate or skip.
Assignment flag that shows the guide to a random half of new trials and records the arm.
Dismiss the guide, and reopen it from the help menu.

first_version.text: Guide panel with three steps at first login.
Random half assignment with the arm recorded.
Dismiss and reopen from the help menu.

later.text: Starter template picker, only if its fake-door test passes.

non_goals.text: Any public ranking of trial users.

release.timeframe: About two sprints for the first version, then a 28-day test window.

constraints: The welcome email schedule stays as it is until the test ends.

acceptance_criteria.given: a new trial user in the guide arm at first login
acceptance_criteria.then: the guide panel shows exactly 3 steps

trace.rationale: Three steps match the shortest path to a first project.

acceptance_criteria.then: between 45 and 55 percent are in the guide arm and every trial has an arm recorded

trace.rationale: Random assignment is the only way to learn the guide's effect (st-u-effect).

acceptance_criteria.given: a user who dismissed the guide
acceptance_criteria.then: the guide reopens at the step they left

trace.rationale: Experienced users must be able to leave the guide without losing it.

acceptance_criteria.then: 7-day activation in the guide arm is at least 36 percent

handoff.notes: Design review of the panel first; engineering only after the product manager accepts this draft.

next_action.action: Product manager reviews this draft and accepts or edits it before design review.
